title: Envelope lettering transferred onto developed X-ray film

tellings.quote: about 200 other X-rays. and um he showed it to me and the lettering from the outside of the envelope that the X-ray was in had somehow been transferred to the developed X-ray film.

plain: Steve Colbern, a scientist who studies objects people say are alien implants, says a doctor he calls Dr. Builder showed him one X-ray out of about 200 on which the lettering printed on the outside of its envelope had somehow been transferred onto the developed film. Colbern says he saw it himself, and tells it as a sign that something unusual had affected the film.
